## iSpotify 19.5.4

This release was prepared automatically after [PR #66](https://github.com/RubinLabs26/ISpotify/pull/66) passed the protected test suite and merged.

### Changes

- deps(deps): update imageio-ffmpeg requirement from <1.0.0,>=0.6.0 to >=0.7.0,<1.0.0

### Downloads

- Windows installer: `ISpotify-Setup-x86_64.exe`
- Windows portable: `ISpotify-windows-x86_64.exe`
- Linux portable: `ISpotify-linux-x86_64`
- Debian/Ubuntu: `ispotify_19.5.4_amd64.deb`

The release is published only after both platform builds succeed.
